blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Merchants and food entrepreneurs from key markets across the Visayas recently gathered in Cebu City for foodpanda’s CRAVE Partner Summit & Awards 2026, highlighting how the platform is actively helping regional food businesses expand their reach, optimize operations, and scale across provincial boundaries. Bringing together restaurant leaders from various regional hubs across Central, Eastern, and Western Visayas, the summit focused on empowering homegrown merchants with the digital tools needed to thrive in a shifting market.
